• NCERT school studies cover core subjects including Science, Social Studies, and Mathematics for middle school students.

• Social Studies covers topics like The Kakatiya Dynasty, How Laws are Made in the State Assembly, and The Indian Constitution.

• Science covers agricultural practices including Crop Production, sowing methods, irrigation systems, and harvesting.
